replacement_rule: Replace interpolation only if copula mean held-out marginal W1 and energy are both no higher, each style mean energy no more than 10% worse, each style held-out coverage drop <=0.05, mean variance ratio in [0.8,1.2], mean rank-correlation RMSE <= interpolation+0.05, exact training-copy rate no higher, and mean model-consistent raw-median sensory W1 <= interpolation+0.02. Otherwise retain interpolation and its diagnosed weaknesses. No post-result retuning.
replacement_rules_machine_checkable: mean model-consistent raw-median sensory W1 <= baseline + 0.02
